entries.en: Hello? Is someone out there?
Lieutenant Ganto Imness of the Third Infiltration Regiment, captured during recon. What was that shooting I heard? I didn't expect such a small-scale assault.
I understand. I tried to speak to them. But I saw friends that no longer knew me. It's better this way.
You are the rescue party, then? In answer to the captain's message? Did the fleet come?
I understand. They were my friends, once. Until their minds were stripped away.
You-- You told me you were fighting the guards. Did you think I wouldn't see this?
I understand why it was necessary, but you shouldn't have lied about it. I would have respected you more if you'd just told me.
What was that noise? What's going on?
Who's there? Can anyone hear me?
Well, you're not a geth. And you're not wearing a lab coat. I guess I'm glad to see you.
Lieutenant Ganto Imness of the Third Infiltration Regiment, captured during recon. I assume the fleet was called in to destroy the base?
I see. Then you must be the infiltration team. I know the captain. He will want this facility destroyed. My team was altered, indoctrinated.
My whole team was... altered. But I was left alone as a control subject. I still have my senses, although I almost wish I didn't.
I watched good people reduced to mindless husks. There wasn't anything left. Others died during the experiments. I envy them.
I don't know much else. I just saw what it did to the others. Turned them into empty husks. I can't end up like that. Please - let me out!
Don't look back and hope to outrun the blast, hmm? A better chance than I had before you showed up.
Thank you, human. And good luck. You'll need it.
The transmission wasn't clear. The fleet is not coming.
Everyone here is indoctrinated. You might be working for Saren.
Do you know anything about the experiments they were conducting?
I'm opening your cell, but then you're on your own.
I disposed of the indoctrinated slaves. It's too dangerous to leave them alive.
It was just some of Saren's people who didn't know when to quit.
It was me ensuring I don't get shot in the back by a mindless idiot.
I had to shoot the prisoners.
Just some guards.
Any indoctrinated must die.
I was sent alone.
Why should I trust you?
Tell me about the research.
I'm letting you out.
No. Don't leave me here! Please!
It's obvious that I'm not crazed or drooling like the others. Let me out and I'll stay out of your way.
If I let you out, how do I know you won't just attack me?
Sorry, I can't take that chance. I'm not opening your cell.
Too risky.
I can't trust you.
He knew about the breeding grounds. But the indoctrination is a greater threat, and far more horrifying.
Sorry, I'm all you get.
Sorry, I'm all you get.
I think I can trust you.
I think I can trust you.
I think I can trust you.
Please -- don't leave me here! I don't want to end up like the others! I saw what those experiments did to them!
They were studying indoctrination. Symptoms, progress. Saren uses it to control his people, but I don't think he fully understands it.
I think I can trust you.
It calls, and I must follow.
The voice is always with me. Whispering.
Every word is the void. It is all I can hear.
There is no escape.
These look docile. Their minds are gone.
Why did Saren do this? To steal a man's mind like that is disgusting.
Are you sure, Shepard? At best they might hurt themselves. If there is any sense left in them, they might be directed to harm us.
Very well. At least the blast will eventually end it.
All right, Commander, but I don't like it.
If that's what you want, Commander. I just hate leaving them like this.
Very well, Commander Shepard.
Yes, Commander.
You sure, Commander? Just leave them wandering? Can't stand the thought of being like that. I'd want to be put out of my misery.
Are you sure? We should at least end this... state they are in.
Are you certain, Commander? It doesn't seem the safest option for us or them.
You sure, Commander? They might hurt themselves.
Should we, Shepard? They might injure themselves. Trivial considering the coming blast, but they are perhaps more comfortable inside.
It's safest, but I would prefer they be put out of their misery.
Okay, Commander, but it's not right. I'd never want to end up like that. Never.
Sometimes you must accept there is nothing you can do to help. It is a great pity.
I wish something could be done. I really do.
They should be dead. That's the only mercy left to them.
Just mow them down, Commander?
I second this question, Shepard. They will die in the blast. Do we need to slaughter them now?
You can't just shoot them, even if they will just die in the blast.
It's what I would want.
I'm with you, Shepard. No way I'd want to end up like that, and they can't outrun the blast anyway. It's all you can do.
I'm all for it. Every second like that must be torture. I know I'd sooner be dead.
Just kill them where they stand, Shepard? Are you certain?
It is all that we can do for them.
I'm with you, Commander. The blast would get them anyway, and damn if I'd want to end up like this. No way.
I've never agreed more, Shepard. It's what I would want.
Why did Saren do this? This is just wrong.
What drove Saren to this? It is cruel beyond measure.
Why did Saren do this? There's just no reason.
This is no way to treat a prisoner. Kill them, sure, but to leave them like this....
No threat here, Commander. Are they even aware of us?
No threat here, Commander. This is... horrible.
They are no threat to anyone save themselves. Their minds are gone.
There's nothing left of them.
Open the doors. Give them a chance to outrun the blast.
Let them out. They won't hurt us.
Open the doors and I'll finish them off.
Leave them. Let's get moving.
Better to die than to live like this.
I don't leave loose ends.
Never mind, then. Just leave them.
It's my call.
Then let's just go.
Let them out.
Safer to keep them here.
Open the door and kill them.
They're no threat.
Eliminate them.
Don't question me.
Don't question me!
It never sleeps.
The voice brings endless night.
From the void. The darkness.
No one will survive.
It is emptiness.
There will be nothing but the voice.
When comes the harvest, so must they reap.
Peace in death.
I am only what it wants me to be.
We are nothing before them.
There will be peace in the silence.
No one escapes.
Let's get the job done, Shepard. I don't want to look at this crap any longer than I have to.
This must be where they are researching the cure for the genophage.
This must be where they're researching the cure for the genophage.
This must be where they're researching the cure for the genophage.
This must be where they're researching the cure for the genophage.
Salarians? Captain Kirrahe said something about losing some men.
Salarians? The captain mentioned he had lost some men.
Salarians? Right. The captain said he had lost some men.
Salarians? Right. The captain said he had lost some of his regiment.
We've got access to base security. Should be able to cut the alarms from here. Might even be able to trigger alarms on the far side of the base.
It'll clear the guards out for us, but they might be too much for Lt. Alenko and the salarians to handle.
If we keep stragglers from spreading the word to additional teams, we should be able to handle things.
Very well. If we can prevent stragglers from spreading the word to additional teams, we should be able to handle things.
As long as we keep stragglers from finding reinforcements, we should be able to handle things.
Fair enough. If we stop stragglers from spreading the word to additional teams, we should be able to handle things.
Aye, aye, Commander. I hope Alenko's paying attention.
I hope they are ready for this.
I hope they're ready for this.
I hope they're ready for this.

It'll clear the guards out for us, but they might be too much for the salarian teams to handle.

It'll clear the guards out for us, but they might be too much for the salarian teams to handle.
Just disable the alarms. We can handle any guards inside.
Williams can take a few more. Minimize the guard presence in the base.
They've got enough trouble.
They can handle it.

Commander. As long as we keep stragglers from spreading the word to additional teams, we should be able to handle things.
Aye, aye, Commander. I hope Williams is ready for this.
Salarians? The captain said something about losing some men.
This more of that indoctrination we've heard about, Commander? What's going on here?
This has to be more of that indoctrination we've heard about, Commander. What is this place?
It appears to be more indoctrination at work. I am beginning to wonder about the purpose of this place.
Is this because of indoctrination? What's going on here?
They were indoctrinated. What's going on in this place?
The captain was flanked. Aegohr, form up with Jaeto. We need to stall for time!
The captain was flanked. Aegohr, form up with Jaeto. We need to stall for time!
Give a little ground, Williams. We don't want them to bunker-up. Draw them out.
Give a little ground, Lieutenant. We don't want them to bunker-up. Draw them out.
Krogan reinforcements! Jaeto, hold your ground! Damn it! We're being flanked!
Krogan reinforcements! Jaeto, hold your ground! We're being flanked!
Okay... can we hold them here? Damn it, fill those holes! Come on, Shepard. Hurry it up.
Okay... hold them here. Fill those holes! Come on, Shepard. Make it soon.
The geth are turning from your position, Jaeto. Looks like Shadow kicked a sensitive spot! Williams, head them off! Hold them out here!
The geth are turning from your position, Jaeto. Looks like Shadow kicked a sensitive spot! Alenko, head them off! Hold them out here!
The geth are turning! Shepard must be getting close. Jaeto, circle around! Keep them here! Keep them....
The geth are turning! Shepard must be nearing the target. Jaeto, keep them here! Circle around and....
Alenko can take a few more. Minimize the guard presence in the base.
They can handle it.
